InstitutionName.description: The name of the institution in charge of the equipment that produced the measurements.

PowerLineFrequency.description: Frequency (in Hz) of the power grid at the geographical location of the instrument (for example, 50 or 60).

Manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of the equipment that produced the measurements. For example, TDT, Blackrock.

SamplingFrequency.description: Sampling frequency (in Hz) of all the data in the recording, regardless of their type (for example, 2400).

RecordingDuration.description: Length of the recording in seconds (for example, 3600).

EpochLength.description: Duration of individual epochs in seconds in case of epoched data

SoftwareFilters.description: Object of temporal software filters applied, or 'n/a' if the data is not available. Each key-value pair in the JSON object is a name of the filter and an object in which its parameters are defined as key-value pairs (for example,).

HardwareFilters.description: Object of temporal hardware filters applied, or 'n/a' if the data is not available. Each key-value pair in the JSON object is a name of the filter and an object in which its parameters are defined as key-value pairs (for example,).

BodyPart.description: Body part of the organ / region scanned (e.g. BRAIN).

BodyPartDetails.description: Additional details about body part or location.

ecephys_datafile_path.description: Location of the corresponding data file(s) or directory
